chapters.text: OBS receives the live Game Capture feed through a VDO.Ninja Source.
Source properties select the stream ID and the experimental native receiver.
The VDO.Ninja Studio dock adds publish controls and shareable viewer links.
Go Live publishes the OBS program to a second VDO.Ninja stream.
A browser viewer is receiving moving video; the dock reports the active connection.
Stop ends OBS publishing. The independent incoming source continues playing.
